description: This file defines an Android Activity named FragmentContextMenu that demonstrates how to display a context menu in a fragment. It includes an inner fragment class that inflates a layout, registers a view for context menu, and handles context menu creation and item selection with toast notifications.

classes.name: FragmentContextMenu
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating context menu in a fragment

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the fragment to the activity

classes.name: ContextMenuFragment
classes.description: Inner fragment class handling the UI and context menu logic

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout and registers a view for context menu

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates the context menu with two items

methods.name: onContextItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of context menu items, showing toast messages
